'''2008 Tatooine Regionals''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG regional championship played on Saturday 21 June 2008 at Press Box Sports Cards, 10261 S 1300 E, Sandy, Utah, organized by [[Scott Church]], the day after the [[2008 Utah State Championship]] at the same store.<ref name="sf-19270-305519">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=305519#p305519 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], CategoryOneGames.com (Scott Church), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (4 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125175520/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270-start60.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Aaron Nelson]] finished first of twelve players; because he already held a bye from the state championship, the two byes into Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]] went to [[Joe Olson]] and [[Scott Church]].<ref name="sf-19270-308762">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=308762#p308762 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], CategoryOneGames.com (Scott Church), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (22 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125175129/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270-start140.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Press Box Sports Cards, 10261 S 1300 E, Sandy, Utah<ref name="sf-19270-305519" />
* '''Dates:''' 21 June 2008<ref name="sf-19270-305519" />
* '''Time:''' 11:00 am start, registration from 10:30 am<ref name="sf-21362-307955">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=307955#p307955 Road to Worlds - Western US - All West States Events/Plans], Advocate (Scott Lingrell), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (17 June 2008).</ref>
* '''Format:''' constructed, six rounds; a top four was planned<ref name="sf-19270-305519" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="sf-19270-305519" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Scott Church]]<ref name="sf-19270-305519" />
* '''Judge:''' one head judge who did not play<ref name="sf-19270-270348">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=270348#p270348 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], CategoryOneGames.com (Scott Church), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (24 February 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125174919/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Results ==

Church posted the results on the evening of the event: play started at 10:30 am and ended by 6 pm. The top four was not played, because the group from Las Vegas and California wanted to start the drive home; Olson and Church conceded to Nelson and Shannon, and Shannon to Nelson. With Nelson holding the bye from the previous night, Olson and Church took the two byes into Day 2. Church thanked Olson for help with the command cards and Chris for help with rulings, and Jaron Janson's brother for running the day's event.<ref name="sf-19270-308762" /> Cedric Simon confirmed the regional Day 2 bids for Olson and Church.<ref name="sf-19270-315735">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=315735#p315735 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (16 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125175210/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270-start160.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Church's standings give first names; James Lewis later supplied the surnames of Mikey and Todd.<ref name="sf-19270-328115">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=328115#p328115 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], Captain_Twinkie (James Lewis), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (19 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125175257/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270-start180.html Internet Archive]</ref> Light Side went 18–17 overall. Church played Dagobah Asteroids on the Light Side and wrote that Todd Johnson's DBO was one of the best Light Side decks of the day.<ref name="sf-19270-308762" /> Janson, posting as Jerba, thanked Church: "your events are the best I've ever been to".<ref name="sf-19270-308792">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=308792#p308792 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], Jerba (Jaron Janson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (22 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125175129/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270-start140.html Internet Archive]</ref>
